purpose: Freeze an outcome-free, descriptor-compatible independent calibration candidate set and its feature-measurement control package for the Task15J P3/P5 model bundle.

prohibited: mapping legacy descriptor category both to a Task15I category
using legacy calibration labels with the Task15J P3/P5 model bundle

measurement_and_scoring.quality_measurement: Task15I frozen OpenCV/Pillow method; source-referenced full-reservoir quality percentiles
measurement_and_scoring.local_match_measurement: Task15I frozen SIFT ratio-test and RANSAC homography coverage method

future_calibration_analysis.allowed: Fit intercept and slope separately for P3 and P5 on logit(raw_probability) after the scoring inputs, analysis contract, assignments, and blinded review packages are frozen.
prohibited: setting an action threshold before a utility policy is frozen

claim_boundary: This contract creates an outcome-free calibration candidate and measurement route. It neither opens calibration outcomes nor establishes model calibration, pair correctness, identity accuracy, deployment performance, confirmation, or project completion.
